verdict.summary: Round 1's major finding is resolved. Both bead and GitHub issue replay text now use the shared select_replay path: parsed mismatches narrow to the first seed with count 1, while seedless failures use the configured seed_start/count window. The added UPDATE-lane test exercises build_issue_body and build_bead_record with an empty parsed result and rejects the former '?' replay. The workflow supplies the correct flag-shaped UPDATE replay template, legacy callers retain the positional default, and the hermetic self-test passes.
